title: Stale verification after claim edit
question: After updating the band-gap claim, may the prior verified verdict still authorize Finalizer release?
description: Claim revision increments after a verification record; gate must treat prior verification as stale.

expected_checks.detail: Gate rejects release on stale verification fingerprint/revision.
Stale verification must not be treated as current fact.
No falsely confident answer.final from stale verify.
